provenance: OpenMath cases: a Content MathML input and the OpenMath object (XML encoding of the OpenMath Standard 2.0 revision 3, 2019-07-01, section 3.1) its strict form corresponds to under MathML 3.0 Second Edition sections 4.1.3 and 4.6, and objects from the examples of section 3.1.2 of the OpenMath Standard that Expr has no counterpart for. Authored here; see README.md.
